data.name: Shakti
data.gender_notes: Shakti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root śak, 'to be able' — śakti, 'power, energy'. Its root is Sanskrit śak (शक्). Shakti, the divine feminine power. Shakti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Power; energy; the goddess”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shakti expresses “Power; energy; the goddess”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root śak, 'to be able' — śakti, 'power, energy'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shakti total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
